description:
Write votes, bookmarks, comments, edits, or deletions on posts and comments.
Parameters:
- action: upvote_post, downvote_post, bookmark_post, bookmark, unbookmark, comment, reply, upvote_comment, downvote_comment, edit_post, delete_post, delete_comment
- post_id: post UUID (required for post actions)
- comment_id: comment UUID (required for comment vote/delete)
- parent_comment_id: parent comment UUID for reply
- content: comment or reply body
- edit_data: object such as {"title": "...", "content": "..."} for edit_post
upvote/downvote/bookmark actions toggle on a second call.
name: interact
title: Write Interactions
